result.summary: Verdict FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895. Read-only review of host/origin validation, DNS/IPv6, forwarding headers, rebinding protection and transport options. No CRITICAL/HIGH: the exact url.hostname allowlist evaluated on the wire authority resists every bypass probe (Host: evil.example -> 403; duplicate Host -> first validated; absolute-form target authority validated; X-Forwarded-* ignored). 2 MEDIUM + 2 LOW. F1 MEDIUM src/http.ts:18 - SWARMFORGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS is compared case-sensitively against WHATWG-lowercased url.hostname, so 'MCP.Example.Test', a trailing-dot FQDN, or an entry with a port never matches and every route returns a silent 403; config.ts:12 lowercases for its own check, proving intent, and loadConfig never rejects an unmatchable entry. F2 MEDIUM src/http.ts:31 - Origin is compared to url.origin derived from the plaintext listener, so the TLS-terminating reverse proxy that ENVIRONMENT.md:33 and the README instruct operators to use 403s every request that carries Origin, including /health and /events. F3 LOW src/serve.ts:179 - the metrics listener enforces neither host allowlist nor bearer on the same non-loopback bind host the config validator protects (reproduced 200 for any Host, no credential). F4 LOW src/runtime.ts:53 - startup banner prints unparseable URLs for IPv6 binds (http://::1:8787/mcp, http://:::8787/mcp) though handle.url and the listener are correct; pre-existing. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json.
result.details:
SCOPE: src/http.ts, src/config.ts, src/serve.ts, src/serve-command.ts, src/cli/arguments.ts, src/runtime.ts, src/cli.ts, src/cli/client.ts, src/metrics.ts, src/settings/{load,inspect}.ts, docs (ENVIRONMENT.md, CONFIGURATION.md, SERVE.md, OBSERVABILITY.md, ARCHITECTURE.md), tests/http.test.ts.

F1 MEDIUM src/http.ts:18. Allowlist Set built at 9-19 from raw config strings (13-16) and compared to the lowercased url.hostname. REPRODUCED on a real listener with a valid bearer: allowed_hosts=MCP.Example.Test -> 403; Mcp.Example.Test -> 403; mcp.example.test -> 200; mcp.example.test:8787 -> 403. Control: Host: LOCALHOST -> 200 against the default lowercase allowlist, proving normalisation is wire-side only. WHY GUARDS MISS IT: config.ts:135-141 only checks token presence; config.ts:10-12 lowercases, showing case-insensitivity is intended; tests/http.test.ts:62-124 only ever uses lowercase portless mcp.example.com. Widened by the new server.allowed_hosts field at src/settings/load.ts:272-277. FIX: lower-case and strip trailing dots from entries in http.ts; add a superRefine rejecting unmatchable entries so config validate fails loudly.

F2 MEDIUM src/http.ts:31. REPRODUCED: Host mcp.example.test + Origin https://mcp.example.test -> 403; Host mcp.example.test:443 + Origin https://... -> 403; control Origin http://mcp.example.test -> 406, i.e. it reached the MCP transport, isolating the cause. No Forwarded/X-Forwarded-Proto support anywhere; SDK enableDnsRebindingProtection left at default false (node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/sdk/dist/esm/server/webStandardStreamableHttp.js:79). WHY GUARDS MISS IT: tests/http.test.ts:22-29 tests only the hostile-origin direction, never a same-host https Origin; ENVIRONMENT.md:33 says to set ALLOWED_HOSTS for a reverse proxy and the README defers TLS externally, so termination is the intended shape yet no doc requires the proxy to preserve a plaintext scheme. FIX: accept an explicit allowed-origins list and/or opt-in forwarded-scheme trust limited to bearer-authenticated requests, trimming default ports; otherwise document the Origin rewrite requirement and add the positive test.

F3 LOW src/serve.ts:177-191. REPRODUCED via real startServer with SWARMFORGE_HOST=0.0.0.0 + token: API 18787 -> 401/403; metrics 19090 -> 200 for Host 127.0.0.1, evil.example and attacker-controlled.example with no credential, exposing team labels plus worker/inference/token counters. tests/serve.test.ts:530-542 fetches metrics only from 127.0.0.1. Documented at ENVIRONMENT.md:45 (protect externally), hence LOW. FIX: route the metrics fetch through the same host allowlist and/or require an explicit opt-in for a non-loopback bind.

F4 LOW src/runtime.ts:50-56 via src/serve-command.ts:148-161. REPRODUCED: real renderStartup gives http://::1:8787/mcp for ::1 and http://:::8787/mcp for ::; real startServer on ::1 reports handle.url http://[::1]:8787 and /health 200, so only the TTY banner is wrong. src/serve.ts:110-113 brackets correctly; line 50 maps 0.0.0.0 but not ::. Pre-existing; tests bind only 127.0.0.1. FIX: share one bracketing helper and map :: to [::1].

VERIFIED GOOD: exact allowlist on the wire authority before routing and before /health,/events,/mcp; first duplicate Host is the one validated; absolute-form target authority is validated per RFC 9112 3.2.2; X-Forwarded-Host/Proto/For ignored; ordering host(403) then bearer(401) then origin(403) avoids credential probing on an unlisted host; wire Host case-insensitive.

REVIEWER EXPERIMENTS (outside the checkout, disclosed): /tmp/opencode/review20/probe/{host,wire,allowlist,ipv6,metrics}-probe.ts, all exit 0, using the repo's own FakeProvider/FakeAgent and in-memory or /tmp SQLite. No cloud/model/network provider contacted, no smoke test, no secret file read, no source edits or commits. /workspace/repo left at baseline 5672ead2a526e07fea9ed11e58b3725e42013527, clean.

ARTIFACTS: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md (16.3 KiB), /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/findings.json (11.6 KiB), logs /workspace/.swarmforge/logs/host-{probe-1,wire,allowlist,ipv6,metrics}-probe.log. No credentials present.

result.followup_reason: Four actionable findings in scope. MEDIUM: (1) src/http.ts:18 compares SWARMFORGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS case-sensitively against the lowercased url.hostname, so uppercase, trailing-dot or port-bearing entries silently 403 every route - normalise entries and reject unmatchable ones in config; (2) src/http.ts:31 compares Origin to url.origin derived from the plaintext listener, so the documented TLS-terminating reverse proxy 403s every request carrying Origin - adopt an explicit allowed-origins list or opt-in forwarded-scheme trust, and add the missing positive test next to tests/http.test.ts:22-29. LOW: src/serve.ts:179 metrics listener enforces no host allowlist and no bearer on a non-loopback bind; src/runtime.ts:53 prints unparseable IPv6 startup URLs while src/serve.ts:110-113 brackets correctly.
